newsitem.title: ROMANIA: Romania denies report on winners in GSM tender.
newsitem.headline: Romania denies report on winners in GSM tender.

text.p: Romania's communications ministry on Friday said it could not confirm reports in the local media that a consortium led by AirTouch Communications Inc of the U.S. and France Telecom had won a GSM tender in Romania.
"I can't confirm what's written in Adevarul. I have no other comment," ministry counsellor Ion Matei said.
On Friday, independent daily newspaper Adevarul said a ministry commission had designated the two consortia as winners in the bid, out of the six which took part in competition.
It did not give a source for the information.
September 26 was the deadline for entry to the tender.

Italy's Stet Spa, France's Bouygues, Telecom Finland, Air Touch Communications Inc of the United States, U.S. Telecoms group Motorola, Tele Danmark and Norway's Telenor have also submitted offers for the two lucrative licences to install and operate a new GSM digital cellular phone system in Romania.

The tender requires companies to be able to cover at least 65 percent of Romania with the GSM system, to have solid operating experience and financial strength to back the costs of the $1.0 billion project.

The project, expected to become operational last year, was delayed by lack of free frequencies on the 900 MHZ waveband as well as by political turmoil in the ministry. -- Adrian Dascalu, Bucharest Newsroomn 40-1 3120264
